description: Create AI-generated product images. **Consumes credits — confirm with the user first.** Only `category: "CLOTHING"` is accepted by the API today. Defaults to ONE product per request (all colors go in a single `colors` array; split only on explicit user request). **Do NOT guess colors/fabrics/features/laundryTips from filenames or category — ask the user.** Generation is asynchronous: poll `get_product` until status leaves CREATING. Read resource `gency://api-reference/products` for the full ProductMetadata schema (category enum, additionalInfo, sizeTables format).

features.description: Product features (e.g., ['슬림핏','베이직 무드']). REQUIRED — ask the user; do NOT guess.

laundryTips.description: Care tips (e.g., ['30도 이하 찬물 세탁']). REQUIRED — ask the user; do NOT fabricate.

sizeTables.description: Single 2D size chart (header row + value rows). All strings; '' for empty. Omit if no chart. See `gency://api-reference/products` for format.

category.description: **Use `CLOTHING`.** The Gency API currently rejects every other value with `현재 CLOTHING 카테고리만 지원됩니다` — the remaining enum members (OUTER/TOP/BAG/RING/…) are reserved for a future rollout and will fail today. Full list: `gency://api-reference/products`.

colors.description: Colors (e.g., ['블랙','화이트']). REQUIRED — ask the user; do NOT infer from filenames. Multiple colors stay in ONE product unless user explicitly splits.

fabrics.description: Fabrics (e.g., ['면 100%']). REQUIRED — ask the user; no generic defaults.

images.description: Image IDs from get_upload_url. Min 6 per product. First image = primary thumbnail.

projectId.description: 관리명 — workspace-unique identifier. Auto-generated if omitted.

templateId.description: Template ID. REQUIRED — call list_templates first and let the user pick.

name: create_product
